reason: Backend-only fixes for three audit leftovers. (1) provider_turn_queue rows now follow their turn when it ends outside admission release (stop while parked, approval stop, supervisor stop, failed unresumable wait, cancel before admission), startup and the recovery tick close open rows of ended or missing turns in SQL off the event loop, recover() releases running rows as the turn stands, and _complete reads status in SQL. A turn whose admission or execution claim fails in _run_provider_turn now fails with an actionable error and a closed row (a restart-recovery resume returns to interrupted with its automatic retry pending, row parked); _resume_stopped_turn shares that retry helper (test_chat restart-recovery tests). Covered by the scheduler/admission tests (test_chat_throughput), restart recovery and startup-robustness tests (test_restart_recovery_lifecycle, test_startup_unreadable_rows), stop/cancel and turn-outcome paths (test_turn_outcome_history, test_chat, test_chat_tool_loop, test_native_hook_turn_ends), approval park/resume (test_approval_continuation) and subagent waits and failures (test_chat_subagents, test_subagent_delivery). (2) ExecutionAI._context reads one execution's output events through replay_operation_events (new event_types filter): test_execution_ai, test_storage. (3) CompanionBroker marks schema/request-model/region refusals before execution: test_browser_companion, test_tool_failures, and test_harnesses for the harness gateway that calls the same broker.
exclusions: Full suites are not approved and are excluded. No UI, native or Playwright changes: frontend, native and playwright are empty because no ui/ or Rust file changed and no operator-visible control or copy changed (the queue row state is not shown in the UI; queue position and metrics only count queued rows). Mission tests are not selected: missions never attach the conversation browser companion and agent_tooling's before-execution handling is unchanged. test_executions.py is not selected: execution event writing is unchanged; the new read is covered by test_execution_ai. python_browser is true because tests/v3/test_browser_companion.py::test_real_chromium_capture_retains_fields_and_rejects_changed_document launches Chromium.
